title: A time tracker
oneLine: What you spent your day on, by app and window.
why: ActivityWatch already does the tracking for free and is open source. What people pay for is the dashboard on top. That dashboard is exactly the kind of thing a beginner can build in a day.
tool: ActivityWatch for the data; any AI tool for the dashboard
keep: Cross-device sync, the pretty weekly email, AI 'focus scores'.
breaks: Nothing much. ActivityWatch is mature and local.
